body_es: BASE (Basically Available, Soft state, Eventually consistent) es un modelo alternativo a ACID para sistemas distribuidos. Mientras ACID busca garantizar consistencia inmediata, BASE prioriza disponibilidad y permite inconsistencia temporal. Basically Available significa que el sistema responde incluso si está degradado. Soft state indica que datos pueden cambiar sin entrada (replicación asíncrona). Eventually consistent promete que los datos convergerán a un estado consistente. BASE es apropiado para sistemas con alta carga y tolerancia a inconsistencia temporal.
body_en: BASE (Basically Available, Soft state, Eventually consistent) is an alternative model to ACID for distributed systems. While ACID seeks immediate consistency guarantees, BASE prioritizes availability and allows temporary inconsistency. Basically Available means the system responds even if degraded. Soft state indicates data can change without input (asynchronous replication). Eventually consistent promises data will converge to consistent state. BASE is appropriate for high-load systems with tolerance for temporary inconsistency.
